newsitem.title: USA: Apartment Investment regnotiates loan rate.
newsitem.headline: Apartment Investment regnotiates loan rate.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co will save about $50,000 a year on its $50 million credit facility with Bank of America as a result of renegotiating the loan's interest with Bank of America, an Apartment Investment executive said.

The new interest rate is charged at LIBOR plus 145 basis points, a savings of 17.5 basis points. That translates to a savings of about $50,000 annually for the company, vice chairman Peter Kopaniez said.
He added that the loan, which the company first signed in June, runs until July 1998. At that point, the company has the option to renew it for another three years, he said.
